extracted.name: Pumpkin Butterscotch Cookies
extracted.description: This pumpkin butterscotch cookie recipe is made with pumpkin purée and butterscotch chips, deliciously spiced with cinnamon, with a cake-like texture.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar, or as needed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper; grease paper with butter.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together in a bowl. Set aside.

Beat white sugar and eggs together in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment until smooth and creamy. Scrape down the sides of the bowl and paddle with a rubber spatula. Beat in pumpkin purée, oil, and vanilla extract on low speed until blended.
Beat flour mixture into pumpkin mixture on low speed until just incorporated: fold in butterscotch chips.
Drop ¼ cupfuls of dough 2 ½ inches apart onto the prepared baking sheets: slightly flatten dough tops with a spatula.

Bake in the preheated oven until edges are golden, about 15 minutes. Cool on baking sheets briefly before transferring cookies to a wire rack to cool completely. Sprinkle cookies with confectioners' sugar.
